name: Synthwave Sunset
author: Violet
font: Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
css: .bg::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:31%;width:190px;height:190px;margin-left:-95px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe66d 0%,#ff9a3c 38%,#ff3c8e 70%,#c026d3 100%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 0 52%,transparent 52%),repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0 9px,transparent 9px 14px);opacity:.7;z-index:0;animation:swSun 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes swSun{0%{transform:translateY(6px);filter:brightness(.95)}100%{transform:translateY(-6px);filter:brightness(1.15)}}.bg::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:-60%;right:-60%;bottom:0;height:96%;z-index:1;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,60,200,.75) 2px,transparent 2px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,60,200,.75) 2px,transparent 2px);background-size:46px 46px;transform:perspective(420px) rotateX(52deg);transform-origin:50% 100%;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,#000 60%,transparent 99%);animation:swGrid 1.1s linear infinite}@keyframes swGrid{to{background-position:0 46px}}.app::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;border-radius:inherit;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 2px,rgba(0,0,0,.07) 2px 3px)}.brand-name{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 6px #ff3cc8,0 0 14px #ff3cc8,0 0 24px #7c3aed;animation:swNeon 3s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes swNeon{0%,100%{opacity:1}92%{opacity:1}93%{opacity:.55}94%{opacity:1}96%{opacity:.7}97%{opacity:1}}.orb{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff 0%,#ffe66d 15%,#ff3c8e 50%,#7c3aed 85%)}.empty h1{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,60,200,.7)}.msg.user{box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,60,200,.45)}.msg.assistant{backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}.input-wrap:focus-within{border-color:#ff3cc8;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,60,200,.5),0 0 24px rgba(255,60,200,.35)}.send{box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,60,200,.55)}.app.paused .bg::before,.app.paused .bg::after,.app.paused::after{animation-play-state:paused!important}.app.no-motion .bg::before,.app.no-motion .bg::after{animation:none!important}
